evidence.note: A numbered, dated step list sits beside the mirror diagram and grows one entry per step for the whole slide.

Capture-the-flag overlay card ('Exploit a deliberately vulnerable target to extract a secret flag') appears while the timeline adds the same idea as prose: 'Agents attack deliberately vulnerable targets to capture flags'.
'Some had no solution' card is restated by the timeline sub-item 'Some tasks have no solution'.

One step adds the zero-day/admin-access entry, opens the mirror lock, highlights an agent, adds a document icon and a quote about agents building a bulletin board: two ideas (access, coordination) at once.

Timeline 'Agent load crashes the mirror' narrates the crash the diagram shows (pile of documents, red dot), and the card already says the rebuild wiped the board before step 6's timeline entry says the same.
Timeline 'Security response rebuilds mirror' restates the diagram returning to a locked, clean mirror.

rationale: A persistent step list beside the diagram restates in prose what the overlays and diagram states show (CTF and no-solution bullets duplicate their cards; crash and rebuild entries narrate the diagram), matching the fail anchor. Step 3 also lands two ideas at once (admin access and the coordination board). This fits the fail descriptor of prose duplicating the visual and a step adding several ideas.
